entries.what: First day at Flats High: Dulce walks the 12 minutes down Vinca through the backed-up drop-off line and gets her schedule: geometry, English 10, chemistry with Ms. Tolentino, history, PE, Spanish.
entries.outcome: Finds all six classes and her locker on the first try.

entries.what: Third period chemistry with Ms. Tolentino; she is paired with Karina as lab partner. PE starts with a volleyball unit.
entries.outcome: Karina and Dulce agree to split the lab notebook.

entries.what: Lunch at the planters by the B wing with Brianna, Karina and Sienna, swapping schedules and complaining about early drop-off.
entries.outcome: The whole group has lunch together, and they plan boba for Friday.

entries.what: At home in unit 114 she tells her mom Yesenia about the day and sorts through the stack of syllabi.
entries.outcome: Asleep around 11:30 after scrolling the group chat.

entries.what: School day: geometry numbers come easily, and Ms. Tolentino hands out the lab safety sheet. Principal Ocampo's attendance push means teachers are tracking who is absent.
entries.outcome: Safety sheet signed and returned.

entries.what: After school she fills out the work permit form for the taquería and gets it ready for the school office.
entries.outcome: Yesenia signs it at the kitchen table.

entries.what: Evening homework at the kitchen table; she finishes geometry fast but leaves English reading for later.
entries.outcome: Geometry done, reading half done.

entries.what: Heat wave begins and the school runs a minimum day; Dulce walks home in 100-degree heat.
entries.outcome: Home by early afternoon with a sweaty backpack.

entries.what: Picks up the school-issued work permit from the office. It limits her to 18 hours on school weeks.
entries.outcome: Permit in hand, so she can start Friday.

entries.what: Cools off at home with the fan on and texts the group chat about the heat and her first shift.
entries.outcome: Chat jokes about free tacos.

entries.what: Another minimum day in the heat. Chemistry is a short lab-safety review, and the B wing planters are too hot, so lunch moves into the shade.
entries.outcome: The group eats under the breezeway.

entries.what: Yesenia gives her a quick rundown of how to take the 22 bus down Calle Ortega for work tomorrow.
entries.outcome: Plan set: bus there, Rafael brings her home.

entries.what: Lays out her black shirt for tomorrow and does a little geometry homework, then goes to bed.
entries.outcome: Asleep a bit late from nerves.

entries.what: School in the heat, then the 22 bus down Calle Ortega. Efraín shows her the register and the ticket pen rule, and Camila walks her through orders.
entries.outcome: First shift starts 4 p.m. at $16.50 an hour on Fridays 4-9; she takes orders with only a few mistakes.

entries.what: Eats her free quesadilla on break, and Héctor teases her about slow tickets. She learns paychecks come every other Friday by check and opens a phone fund goal of $220.
entries.outcome: Phone fund started in her head and notes app.

entries.what: Rafael picks her up after the 9 p.m. close in the heat-warm night. She asks for help wording a thank-you text, worried it sounds cringe.
entries.outcome: Sends a short thanks text that she thinks is not cringe.

entries.what: Saturday laundry at the card-only room at Marisol Gardens while the heat wave lingers.
entries.outcome: Two loads done and folded.

entries.what: Takes a break at the library, which is open as a cooling center, and gets a start on English reading.
entries.outcome: Reads two chapters.

entries.what: Evening video chat with the girls about first-week gossip, and she works on an edit video she never posts.
entries.outcome: Stays up a little late.

entries.what: Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima after the 22 bus. She takes lunch rush orders and gets quicker at the register.
entries.outcome: Finishes the shift and counts her tips.

entries.what: She counts the hours worked so far against the permit's 18-hour limit and tells her mom how much her first check might be.
entries.outcome: Hours are within the limit.

entries.what: Evening homework and an early bedtime before Monday classes.
entries.outcome: Bag packed for Monday.

new_facts.value: wears black slip-resistant sneakers borrowed from her mom for shifts

new_facts.value: calls Dulce 'Rayo' as a joke about her slow tickets

new_facts.subject: dulce
new_facts.value: group plans Cloud Nine boba after school next Friday before her shift

new_facts.subject: dulce
new_facts.value: worked 5 hours Friday and 6 hours Sunday in her first week

new_facts.subject: karina
new_facts.value: keeps the lab notebook in purple pen for the pair
